title: 第3689章 无奈之举本尊势在必得第3688章 破坏平衡表决
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
各星域国之间若真出现了什么矛盾，也是由联邦国议员进行商议，经共同裁决处理。
一个能够让人族未来腾飞的机会，就这么白白流失。
换做是谁，都会因此而生气。
“卡洛斯，现在就我们七人同意可没用。
除非能有半数以上巅峰主宰同意帮助叶凌，否则我们也不能随意出手。”
扎巴鲁斯无奈的耸耸肩，一脸爱莫能助的样子。
若是空没有闭关，由他亲自提出这个提议，其他人自然不会有意见。
以空的号召力，绝大部分巅峰主宰必然会同意他的提议。
只可惜，空现在正忙着闭关，根本没闲暇顾及其他事情。
皱了皱眉，卡洛斯捏了捏眉心，事情还是走到了他不愿意看到的局面。
没有人族的帮助，叶凌想要度过此次危机，难度可想而知。
但现在大部分巅峰主宰都不同意出手，哪怕是他，也绝不能擅自行动。
在这时候贸然行动，必然会被有心之人，比如伊莱亚斯这样的家伙带节奏。
“此事……暂且搁置，空现在正在突破的关键阶段，我们不能打扰。
再等等看吧，或许叶凌能够创造奇迹也说不定。
若他真遇到了必死的危机，我们再出手帮他。”
卡洛斯说出最后这句话，是顶着不小的压力的。
事情真要是走到那个地步，真正能出手帮助叶凌的，恐怕也就只有他们几人。
扎巴鲁斯等人心照不宣地点点头，他们自然是希望人族强盛。
若是能够保住一个人族天骄，助力人族未来走向更高的层次，他们愿意为之付出。

人族，其中不乏有一些自私的家伙。
但同样也有一些为了人族大义，愿意奉献一切的存在。
他们经历了太多，深知人族想要变得强盛，绝不是一朝一夕的事情。
但凡有机会能让人族在万族中的地位和实力有所提升，增强人族的力量，他们都会为之努力。
会议草草结束，由于伊莱亚斯的提案干预，卡洛斯的提案被否决，叶凌一事只能暂且搁置。
…………
白虎圣地，鬼族领地。
领地中心的至尊殿内。
苍鬼刚刚收到消息，被特意安排在白虎圣地外围巡视的小队，已经全军覆没。
而在得知这个情况后，苍鬼不仅没有感到半分生气，甚至满脸兴奋。
来了！
巡视白虎圣地外围的鬼族小队，实力可都是宇宙主宰。
哪怕其中并没有巅峰宇宙主宰，也绝对不是白虎圣地外的其他势力能随随便便就应付的。
更何况鬼族小队一点消息都没有传回来，便足以说明对他们动手的家伙很强。
事情发生在白虎圣地外，更是直接灭杀掉鬼族小队，能做到这件事情的，苍鬼心中只有一个答案。
叶凌和白娅！
除了这二者外，宇宙中的其他势力可没有这样的能力。
冥蛇那家伙猜对了，白娅真的返回白虎圣地复仇。
踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费工夫。
此前他还不好将事情摆在明面上，更不好亲自出手。

可现在，苍鬼已然没有这样的担忧。
巡视圣地的鬼族小队被覆灭，这可不是小事。
content_en:
If there is any conflict between the star country countries, it will be discussed by federal parliamentarians and resolved through joint decision-making.
An opportunity that could allow humanity to take off in the future was lost in vain.
Anyone else would be angry because of this.
“Carlos, it’s no use just the seven of us agreeing now.
Unless more than half of the peak masters agree to help Ye Ling, we cannot take action at will. "
Zabarus shrugged helplessly, looking helpless.
If Sora hadn't gone into retreat and he had personally proposed this proposal, others would naturally not have any objections.
With Kong's appeal, most peak masters would definitely agree to his proposal.
It's a pity that Sora is currently in retreat and has no time to take care of other things.
Carlos frowned and pinched his brows, but things still reached a situation he didn't want to see.
Without the help of the human race, it can be imagined how difficult it would be for Ye Ling to survive this crisis.
But now most of the top masters do not agree to take action. Even he can never act without authorization.
If you act rashly at this time, you will inevitably be led by someone with intentions, such as Elias.
"This matter... is put aside for the time being. Sora is currently at the critical stage of breakthrough, and we cannot disturb him.
Just wait and see, maybe Ye Ling can create a miracle.
If he really encounters a fatal crisis, we will help him. "
Carlos said these last words under considerable pressure.
If things really come to that point, they may be the only ones who can really help Ye Ling.
Zabarus and the others nodded tacitly, they naturally wanted the human race to be strong.
If they could keep a talented human being and help the human race move to a higher level in the future, they would be willing to pay for it.
There are many selfish people in the human race.
But there are also some beings who are willing to sacrifice everything for the righteousness of the human race.
They have experienced too much and know that becoming strong as a human race will not happen overnight.
Whenever there is an opportunity to improve the status and strength of the human race among all races and enhance the power of the human race, they will work hard for it.
The meeting ended hastily. Due to the intervention of Elias' proposal, Carlos's proposal was rejected, and Ye Ling's matter could only be put on hold for the time being.

White Tiger Holy Land, the territory of the ghost clan.
In the Supreme Hall in the center of the territory.
Cang Gui had just received the news that the team specially arranged to patrol the periphery of the White Tiger Holy Land had been completely wiped out.
After learning about this situation, Cang Gui not only didn't feel angry at all, but even looked excited.
Coming!
The ghost team patrolling the outskirts of the White Tiger Holy Land are the masters of the universe.
Even if there is no peak universe master among them, it is definitely not something that other forces outside the White Tiger Holy Land can deal with casually.
What's more, no news came back from the ghost team, which is enough to show that the guy who attacked them is very strong.
The incident happened outside the White Tiger Holy Land, and the ghost team was directly killed. Cang Gui had only one answer in his mind for being able to do this.
Ye Ling and Bai Ya!
Apart from these two, no other forces in the universe have such abilities.
The guy from Underworld Snake guessed it right, Bai Ya really returned to the White Tiger Holy Land for revenge.
It takes no effort to get there even if you wear iron shoes.
Before, it was not easy for him to put things out in the open, let alone take action personally.
But now, Cang Gui no longer has such worries.
The ghost team patrolling the Holy Land was destroyed. This was no small matter.
